outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative bright-field and ICG fluorescence photographs of lungs; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Bar graph of mean ICG fluorescence intensity (mean ± SD) has individual data points (blue and red dots for each mouse) overlaid on the bars.
Panel C consists of histology/RNAscope micrographs and spatial expression heatmap-style plots (Cd68, Spp1), not bar/summary plots requiring individual data points.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots showing running enrichment scores; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values per gene derived from differential expression analysis (Seurat FindMarkers) across thousands of spatial spots, a computed statistic rather than a mean of a small number of biological replicates, so individual data points are not expected/practical here.
Panel F shows representative ICG fluorescence and IHC images, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
